spoken_aliases: the derivative with respect to x of cosine of x equals negative sine of x
d by d x of cosine x equals minus sine x

evidence: Use cos(x+h)=cos(x)cos(h)-sin(x)sin(h). Divide the difference by h. The limits sin(h)/h=1 and (cos(h)-1)/h=0 in radians give -sin(x). The second limit follows from cos(h)-1=-2sin(h/2)^2.
